scope: Synthetic native-bridge UI regression using the actual final bundle; not a real Android WebView, TV, phone, LAN server or QR pairing test
inputMethod: Ordinary Chromium keyboard Enter/P and mouse click; no model/state writes or clock overrides

getInfo.qrImageType: valid local SVG data URL; not scanned

tests.name: fresh native English locale retains the LAN address and supplied image
native menu automatically shows all panel text at 960 and 1280
ordinary start hides the panel and P pause restores it without advancing the race
clicking language reloads the exact native URL and persists Chinese over native English
